hyst.reason: DeepSeek and Falcon have persistent late top10 protected-pool churn while their late adjacent high-score pools remain locally stable enough for a hysteresis smoke gate.

lambda.limitation: Current cached packets do not contain causal per-layer recovery curves; a smoke pass is required before any wider LAMBDA claim.
lambda.reason: DeepSeek and Falcon show meaningful layer drift heterogeneity, strong dominant-layer allocation skew, and live trace surfaces with positive M11b-vs-static examples.

hyst.persistent_late_churn: m11b_top10 late adjacent median Jaccard churn >= 0.20

lambda.dominant_layer_signal: global final top-10% allocation max/flat ratio >= 3.0
lambda.meaningful_layer_drift_heterogeneity: activation top-10% drift range >= 0.20 or CV >= 0.10
lambda.trace_surface_alive: at least one positive M11b-vs-static trace and no-gap fraction <= 0.25
